messages:
sara_mkt: Heads up — final interview with Kitewell wrapped this morning. They gave a short soundbite I think is perfect for the launch post: "Redwood cut our inference cost by half while keeping latency stable." Need legal to eyeball, and marketing to lock copy + a webinar invite slot. Can someone own legal and lead routing?

ben_p: Nice. Can you paste the raw quote/audio clip? I want to test a 30s promo cut for the webinar teaser.

sara_mkt: Pasting raw quote below and attaching audio to the thread (upload in Files).

sara_mkt: "Redwood cut our inference cost by half while keeping latency stable across peak traffic."

laura_legal: On it. Quick Q: did Kitewell ask for any embargo or prefered attribution? Need to check the signed release.

amy_cs: They signed the standard advocacy release last week, no embargo but asked that we run final copy by their comms lead. I can DM their PR now.

ben_p: For the webinar, we should route inbound leads from the registration form into SFDC campaign 'Kitewell Launch' and trigger the 1-day nurture sequence. Tom — can you add the campaign/route?

tom_se: Yep. I'll add the Pardot form + SFDC campaign today. Confirm the field mapping: email, company, job_title, interest_level, attended_webinar (Y/N). Any extras?

ben_p: Add 'use_case' free text. We want to tie registrants to benchmark interest (cost vs latency).

laura_legal: Quick redline suggestions for the quote: prefer we avoid absolute phrasing like "half" unless Kitewell confirms exact percent. Suggest: "significantly reduced per-inference cost while keeping latency stable". Also request Kitewell OK on the modified quote.

sara_mkt: Good catch. Amy, can you run the softer variant by their comms? I'll leave the raw and the proposed edit.

amy_cs: Reached out to their PR (cc'd). They replied: fine with the softer wording, can confirm exact number privately but OK to publish "significantly reduced". They asked for the post to include a link to their case repo (public) and for a quote attribution line with job title.

ben_p: Perfect. For the launch post we should A/B headline: (A) "Kitewell cuts inference cost with Redwood" vs (B) "Kitewell slashes LLM unit costs — a launch case". Prefer short-run test in social. Thoughts?

laura_legal: All good on the wording change. Please attach the signed release when you post. Also keep the attribution exactly as they provide.

ops-bot: Reminder: marketing publish checklist requires signed release, comms approval, asset links, and SFDC campaign created before publish.

tom_se: SFDC campaign created: 'Kitewell Launch' (ID 701-2024-KW). Form + mapping done. Webhook to Marketo set up for immediate lead enrichment.

ben_p: Thanks. Sara — once Kitewell confirms, update the final quote and I'll schedule the teaser + webinar registration page. ETA for final confirmation?

sara_mkt: They confirmed in email at 15:12. Final quote: "Redwood significantly reduced our per-inference cost while keeping latency stable during peak traffic." They've provided job title for attribution. I'm attaching the signed release now.

amy_cs: Got it — forwarded to comms, they're happy. No embargo.

ben_p: Great — I'll draft the post and A/B test the two headlines in social promos. Sara, can you review the landing page copy before publish?

sara_mkt: Yup — will review and approve. Launch timeline: publish post + open webinar registration Tue 09:00 PT, promo sequence runs Tue-Fri, webinar Wed next week.

laura_legal: All legal checks complete. Documented redlines in the release file.

ben_p: Moving to final. Thanks team :tada:
